summary: Iteration 10 fully validated. Backend pytest 8/8 pass on test_iteration10.py. GET /api/clubs and /api/clubs/{id} expose price_per_hour on all 12 seed clubs (Padel Horizon Paris=40, Padel Toulouse Sud=28 verified; all seed prices numeric in [10,200]). POST /api/clubs accepts optional price_per_hour and enforces the 0..200 Pydantic bound (999 -> 422, -5 -> 422); omission yields price_per_hour=null; created value round-trips via GET. Frontend UI: club Infos tab renders 'Location du terrain' card with 3 rows testID price-row-1 / price-row-1.5 / price-row-2. Live check on Padel Horizon Paris (40€/h) shows: 1h => 40.00€ terrain / 10.00€ /joueur, 1h30 => 60.00€ / 15.00€, 2h => 80.00€ / 20.00€ — math correct (÷4). /matches Passés tab now lists only 4/4 matches (confirmed a 3/4 card is absent from Passés; the single visible Passés card is 4/4 and shows the Rejouer button + a full 4-player chip row). Replay button replay-<id> only rendered on is_full cards (upcoming tab: 2 cards with 1/4 have no replay btn, 1 card with 4/4 shows it — spec compliant). Replay modal correctly shows team chips (Toi, JulieSmash, Paul, Sarah), 'Étape 2 : choisis la date et l'heure' hint text, MatchDatePicker (replay-day-<i> / replay-hour-<h>) and replay-confirm — confirming from Passés creates the new match in À venir. suggest-club form exposes suggest-price numeric input. Group counts show correctly (À venir 5, En cours 1, Passés 1). Regression OK: auth, favorites list, history serialization (is_full/status/match_date/total_players present). Only cosmetic RN Web 'shadow*' and 'pointerEvents' deprecation warnings remain.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'shadow*' style props are deprecated, use 'boxShadow'. Cosmetic only, non-blocking on native. Reference: multiple StyleSheet.create blocks in /app/frontend/app/**.
Deprecation warning: props.pointerEvents is deprecated, use style.pointerEvents. Cosmetic only. Likely originates from a third-party component (Modal/overlay).

action_items: Optional: migrate remaining shadow* style props to boxShadow and switch pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents to silence RN Web deprecation warnings (non-blocking, does not affect native).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:106-125 ClubOut/ClubCreate correctly expose Optional[float] price_per_hour with Field(ge=0, le=200) — Pydantic enforces the 0..200 bound (422 on out-of-range).
server.py:395-410 suggest_club (POST /clubs) persists body.price_per_hour into the stored club document.
server.py:713-725 PRICE_MAP backfill runs idempotently on startup for both {price_per_hour: None} and {price_per_hour: {$exists: False}} — safe for existing DBs.
matches.tsx:36-41 inGroup() returns is_full && (status in {past, undated}) for the 'past' key — matches spec exactly and filters out 3/4 matches from Passés.
matches.tsx:182-186 replay-<id> button is only rendered when item.is_full — guarantees a 4-name team chip row in the modal.
matches.tsx:224-228 modal shows the exact 'Étape 2 : choisis la date et l'heure' hint before the MatchDatePicker.

club/[id].tsx:170-198 price card renders only when price_per_hour != null; testID price-row-<mult> for 1/1.5/2 with court=price*mult and perPlayer=court/4 (verified visually: 40/60/80 and 10/15/20 for Paris).
suggest-club.tsx:78 suggest-price input has keyboardType='numeric' and forwards the parsed value to api.createClub as price_per_hour.
